question.text: Grievance redressal timeline under SEBI PM Regs is:

explanation.text: The Logic: 21 calendar days. Escalates to SEBI SCORES or ODR if unresolved. The Trap: Sub-21-day targets are good practice but not regulatory minimum. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Track grievances with aging reports; include in Board review quarterly.
